year.label: 2019 Clubsport with the Manthey MR kit

identity.real_world_identity_notes: Customer racing 718 Cayman with the Manthey Racing MR kit. Porsche drives the rear wheels through a dual-clutch PDK gearbox with six gears, and the MR kit revises aerodynamics and suspension without changing the powertrain. A PDK has no clutch pedal, so the real car cannot require clutch input to pull away, even though AMS2 does; that difference is recorded as an explicit simulator override rather than by asserting something false about the car.

wheel_rim.notes: Observed from the cockpit during the guided drive.

notes: Simulator behavior was directly observed in a guided drive with automatic clutch and shifting disabled.
The real car is a six-speed PDK dual clutch and has no clutch pedal, so its standing-start clutch is recorded as not required.

AMS2 1.6.9.91 nonetheless required clutch input to move off. That is recorded as an explicit simulator override, so the in-sim guidance tells the driver to use the clutch while the record keeps the real car's value.
No throttle lift is required on upshifts and no manual blip on downshifts, because the drive detected automatic cut and automatic blip.
Observed live in AMS2 1.6.9.91 via guided verification observation ams2.porsche-cayman-gt4-clubsport-mr.20260813t171028562z-e4f6b4a0 by Jason Kinslow.

overrides.condition: AMS2 1.6.9.91 requires clutch input to move off, although the real car's PDK has no clutch pedal.

confidence.basis: Directly observed in the guided drive with automatic clutch and shifting disabled.

claims.basis: The registered manufacturer source establishes the real-world identity and transmission, and the exact simulator identity was observed live.
Porsche specifies a six-speed dual-clutch PDK and Manthey confirms the MR kit leaves the powertrain unchanged; the live drive confirmed six paddle-selected gears.
Directly observed during the guided drive: move-off, shift clutch use, automatic cut and blip, and the cockpit rim.
The guided drive established that AMS2 requires clutch input to move off, which differs from the real car's clutch-pedal-free PDK.
